LanguageData.SSC_CorruptionGel.label: depravity gel
LanguageData.SSC_CorruptionGel.description: A gel that preserves fragments of pleasure, inducing euphoria when taken. Effects: greatly improves mood and slightly reduces work speed. Each real orgasm adds 2 percentage points of corruption, up to 10 extra points from gel per encounter, within the stage limit. Another dose refreshes duration. SSC masters are immune.
